basics.name: Ruşen Birben
basics.summary: AI and Data Engineering graduate from Istanbul Technical University and independent researcher with METU’s Applied NLP Group. Research interests center on LLM reliability and interpretability, with experience in Turkish NLP, machine unlearning, and LLM applications for finance.
basics.printSummary: AI and Data Engineering graduate from Istanbul Technical University and independent researcher with METU’s Applied NLP Group. Research interests center on LLM reliability and interpretability, with experience in Turkish NLP, machine unlearning, and LLM applications for finance.

experience.description:
Contribute to data creation and evaluation methodology for the SIGTURK 2027 benchmark on Turkic languages and cultural understanding with Çağrı Toraman.

Support LlamaTurk2 through training-data collection and pretraining experiments.

Lead [METU NLP Connect](https://www.youtube.com/@metunlpconnect), producing expert interviews.

Co-founded Fiction Studios at Bilkent Cyberpark; led technical development and coordinated three additional contributors. Built a multilingual LLM-powered museum and tourism guide, alongside customer and investor discussions.

Developed news-sentiment pipelines, internal financial LLM tools, web integrations, and a mobile voice assistant at a Phillip Capital subsidiary. Worked on retrieving current context from fragmented sources and PDF reports.
Investigated software-log analysis for predictive maintenance; developed prototypes using HDFS logs.
Researched financial LLM applications involving sentiment analysis, tool use, reasoning, forecasting, and retrieval-augmented generation. Contributed experiments to the Kaira undergraduate capstone.

projects.title: Kaira
projects.subtitle: Undergraduate Capstone: Financial Reasoning LLM
projects.description: Fine-tuned Qwen-based LLMs with GRPO, Unsloth, and LoRA; ran FinQA and GSM8K experiments on reward design and financial reasoning. Developed an Ollama-based chat application.

projects.title: Tobor
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Warehouse Robot
projects.description: Implemented the box pickup/drop-off mechanism in a team-built ROS2 warehouse robot with navigation and YOLO perception; shared data annotation and supported other algorithms.

projects.title: AIZheimer
projects.subtitle: Machine Unlearning in Stable Diffusion
projects.description: Adapted Forget-Me-Not-based unlearning for Stable Diffusion 2.1. Implemented attention controllers and explored loss objectives; qualitatively assessed concept removal and retention of unrelated generation capabilities.

projects.title: Biting The Bytes
projects.subtitle: Turkish Diacritic Restoration
projects.description: Led ByT5-small training and hyperparameter tuning with PEFT/LoRA for byte-level Turkish diacritic restoration. Shared debugging and Hugging Face Spaces deployment with a teammate.

projects.title: To-AI-or-Not-to-AI
projects.subtitle: GPT Detector
projects.description: Combined three fine-tuned RoBERTa detectors by majority vote. Shared preparation of 26,270 examples; achieved 94.21% accuracy on an in-domain random split, without establishing out-of-domain generalization.

education.degree: Undergraduate studies in Electronics & Communication Engineering

awards.title: 1416 YLSY Scholarship · M.Sc. & Ph.D.
awards.summary: Awarded government funding for overseas master’s study followed by doctoral study, covering tuition fees, a monthly living stipend, health insurance, travel, language-exam fees, and study supplies. Following completion of the funded studies, will return to Türkiye as an assistant professor.

awards.title: Kaggle Bronze Medal · The Pokémon Company PTCG AI Battle Challenge
awards.summary: Ranked 677th of 6,807 teams (top 10%) in Kaggle’s simulation competition, developing and evaluating partially observable game-playing agents with replay-based behavioral cloning, belief-aware Monte Carlo planning, and self-play.

publications.title: Turkish Cultural Knowledge Dataset - MRL 2026
publications.subtitle: Accepted dataset contribution; joint benchmark paper in preparation
publications.description:
Led the source-grounded agent pipeline and data preparation for a Turkish cultural knowledge dataset spanning 15 domains.

Screened 1,200 candidate question-answer pairs; selected 500 for sociological review by Büşra Tufan and prepared the final 300-pair submission.

Contributed to English translation review under the research guidance of Çağrı Toraman.
